```{r}
#| label: setup
pacman::p_load(tidyverse,
               janitor,
               readxl,
               here,
               naniar)
```

# Data loading

```{r}
#| label: load
# Read the downloaded file
df <- here("data", "dirty_data.xlsx") |>
  read_xlsx()
```

# Data exploration

```{r}
#| label: glimpse
# 1. Types and first values
df |>
  glimpse()
```

```{r}
#| label: summary
# 2. Missing values and ranges
df |>
  summary()
```

```{r}
#| label: rows
# 3. Rows and repeated rows. If the two numbers differ, rows repeat
df |>
  count()

df |>
  distinct() |>
  count()
```

```{r}
#| label: dupes
# 4. Which rows repeat
df |>
  get_dupes()
```

```{r}
#| label: empty
# 5. Empty rows and columns. Compare with the dimensions in step 1
df |>
  remove_empty(which = c("rows", "cols")) |>
  dim()
```

## Missing values

```{r}
#| label: miss-table
# Table: missing count and percent per column, most missing first
df |>
  miss_var_summary()
```

```{r}
#| label: miss-plot
# Plot: the same as bars
df |>
  gg_miss_var()
```

```{r}
#| label: miss-map
# Map of the whole table: black cells are missing
df |>
  vis_miss()
```

```{r}
#| label: miss-rows
# Rows with the most missing values
df |>
  miss_case_summary()
```

# Data cleaning

Each chunk updates `df`. Run them in order.

```{r}
#| label: clean-names
# Names: lower case, no spaces
df <- df |>
  clean_names()

df |>
  names()
```

```{r}
#| label: remove-empty
# Drop rows and columns where every cell is missing
df <- df |>
  remove_empty(which = c("rows", "cols"))

df |>
  dim()
```

```{r}
#| label: drop-dupes
# Keep one copy of each repeated row
df <- df |>
  distinct()

df |>
  count()
```

```{r}
#| label: odd-values
#| eval: false
# Look for "-", "n/a", "999" in a text column. Replace column_name with your column
df |>
  tabyl(column_name)
```

```{r}
#| label: na-text
#| eval: false
# Turn text that means missing into NA
df <- df |>
  replace_with_na_all(condition = ~ .x %in% c("-", "n/a", "N/A", "999"))

df |>
  vis_miss()
```

```{r}
#| label: final-check
# Types, missing values, rows
df |>
  glimpse()

df |>
  miss_var_summary()
```
